categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and refactors unit test transaction setup as part of project-wide test cleanup tracking issue #36692.
categories.rationale: This PR is a minor test cleanup that refactors fee estimator unit tests to construct transactions declaratively. Part of tracking issue #36692 ('Declarative construction of test data'), it replaces imperative vector resizing and field mutation with initializer lists and adds an `add_tx` helper in `blockpolicyestimator_tests`. Test code cleanliness ranks lowest among test category priorities, without affecting signal, framework capabilities, or coverage.
